nodes.label: Economy (tax base / market)
nodes.notes: Ultimate source of all own-source revenue at every tier.

nodes.label: Union (Consolidated Fund of India)
nodes.notes: Holds the divisible pool + cesses; disburses devolution, grants, schemes, loans.

nodes.label: State (State Consolidated Fund)
nodes.notes: Receives from Union; funds itself + transfers down to local bodies.

nodes.label: Urban local body (municipal corporation/council)
nodes.notes: The outlier chart (accrual). e.g. AMC on the Gujarat 5-digit code.

nodes.label: RBI e-Kuber
nodes.notes: Under SNA-SPARSH, scheme funds route directly from RBI, bypassing state treasuries.

nodes.label: PFMS / Single Nodal Agency account
nodes.notes: One SNA bank account per CSS per state; just-in-time release, UC-gated, float held in CFI.

nodes.label: Central Nodal Agency
nodes.notes: Holds/disburses 100% Union-funded Central Sector schemes via assignment accounts.
